description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 26th August 2024 to 01 September 2024
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It represents a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under legal/statutory instruments, and involves compliance requirements for international trade - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a government official (Director General of Customs), it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3.
